sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.text_preview: Deen Craft is a business that provides Islamic and customized products such as Prayer Mats, Tasbeeh, Digital Counters, Travel Mats. At the current stage, most business operations are handled manually

sections.title: Overview of Existing System
sections.text_preview: Currently, Deen Craft operates through a manual business process using WhatsApp as the main communication platform. Customers contact the business owner to inquire about products, customization option

sections.title: Working of Existing System
sections.text_preview:
The working of the current system is entirely manual and communication-based. The process includes the following steps:

 Customers initiate contact through WhatsApp.

 The owner shares product imag

sections.title: 1. Manual Communication Dependency
sections.text_preview: The system relies completely on manual WhatsApp communication, which is time-consuming and increases the workload on the business owner.

sections.title: 2. Risk of Missed or Delayed Responses
sections.text_preview: Due to high message volume, especially during peak seasons, there is a higher chance of missed messages and delayed replies to customers.

sections.title: 3. Lack of Inventory Management
sections.text_preview: There is no automated inventory system, which can lead to accepting orders for items that are out of stock.

sections.title: 4. No Order Tracking System
sections.text_preview: Customers cannot track their orders online and must repeatedly contact the owner for updates, increasing unnecessary communication.

sections.title: 5. No Centralized Data Management
sections.text_preview: Customer details, customization requirements, and order records are stored manually, making data management disorganized and difficult to maintain.

sections.title: 6. Difficulty During Peak Seasons
sections.text_preview: During busy periods like Ramadan and Eid, managing a large number of orders becomes overwhelming and increases the chances of errors in order handling.

sections.title: 1.4 Proposed System
sections.text_preview:

sections.title: User Registration and Login
sections.text_preview:
o Users must be able to register using email or mobile number.

o OTP verification and secure login functionality must be supported.

sections.title: Product Browsing and Search
sections.text_preview: o Customers should be able to browse product categories and search products easily.

sections.title: Product Customization
sections.text_preview: o Customers should be able to customize prayer mats, tasbeehs, and other products by entering names, selecting colors, fonts, and materials.

sections.title: Shopping Cart and Checkout
sections.text_preview: o Users must be able to add products to cart, update quantities, and place orders using Cash on Delivery (COD).

sections.title: Order Tracking
sections.text_preview: o Customers should be able to track order status online using Tracking ID.

sections.title: Inventory Management
sections.text_preview: o Admin should be able to manage stock levels and receive low-stock alerts.

sections.title: Notification System
sections.text_preview: o The system should send WhatsApp/SMS notifications for OTPs, order confirmations, dispatch updates, and cancellations.

sections.title: Review and Rating System
sections.text_preview: o Customers should be able to submit reviews and ratings after delivery.

sections.title: Admin Dashboard
sections.text_preview: o Admin should be able to manage products, orders, inventory, discounts, and analytics from a centralized dashboard.
